title: Zero sessions this week: your last workout was Oct 17, and your last leg session was Oct 3.
summary:
Week of Oct 19-25: 0 of 5 sessions. The three weeks before that went 4, 1, 2. Your last logged workout is Upper · Strength on Oct 17 (70 min). Lower · Strength has been next in the app since Oct 2, and the last lower-body work was 17 minutes on Oct 3. That's 22 days without a squat.
No new lifts to judge. The last numbers stand: bench 185x8 (e1RM ~234), barbell row 115x10 (~153, down from 145x8), DB press 20x10 (down from 27.5x12). Nothing in last week's plan has been run, so the plan stays as it is.
Food: 0 of 7 days logged this week. Oct 18 was your best day so far: 1,293 kcal, 150 g protein, 6.3 fruit/veg servings. Then logging stopped. On Oct 22 you changed your targets to 1,200 kcal and 140 g protein. That's too low for a 170 lb man training 5 days a week, and 140 g is under 0.9 g/lb. I've reset them (see Changes).
Body: no weigh-ins this week; last reading is 170.0 on Oct 17. The Watch synced only Oct 19: 6,774 steps, 321 min sleep, RHR 73, HRV 56. VO2 max last read 32.7 (Oct 18), down from 33.3. Still no progress photos.
wins: Oct 18 nutrition was solid: 150 g protein and 6.3 fruit/veg servings in a fully logged day.
You fixed the casein shake entry (now 120 kcal, was logged at 7).
Oct 17 hit 18,333 steps and 432 min sleep. You can do it when you decide to.
misses: Sessions: 0/5 this week. Last 4 weeks: 4, 1, 2, 0. Last workout Oct 17.
Legs: 22 days without a lower-body session (last Oct 3, 17 min). Lower · Strength not done since Oct 2.
Food logging: 0 of 7 days. Protein, calories and fruit/veg: not logged.
Targets set to 1,200 kcal / 140 g protein: about half of maintenance, protein at 0.82 g/lb.
Watch: 1 of 7 days synced. Oct 19: 6,774 steps vs 7,500 standard, 321 min sleep vs 420.
Progress photos: none, third week asking.
Every focus item from Oct 18 missed: no Monday leg day, no 5 sessions, no food logs, no weigh-ins, no photos.
changes: Targets reset from 1,200 kcal / 140 g to 1,900 kcal / 155 g protein. If you want to lean out, fine: 1,900 is a moderate deficit (~400-500 below maintenance) that still lets you train hard and keep muscle. At 1,200 you'll lose strength and quit the plan again. 155 g is 0.91 g/lb, the floor for building muscle in a deficit.
No program changes. None of the last two weeks' plan has been run. Changing an untested plan is guessing; the problem is attendance, not the program.
Kept 5 days. You've missed more than half of your sessions three weeks running, and that's on record. If 5 days really doesn't fit your life, tell me and we'll go to 4. Until then, the target is 5.
focus: Monday Oct 26: Lower · Strength. Squat 4x3-5 at 135, RDL 3x5-8 at 135, then the rest of the list. Log it before you leave the gym. No upper session until it's done.
Floor this week: 4 sessions minimum, 5 is the target, with Legs · Muscle by Thursday. Showing up for 45 minutes beats skipping a 60-minute session.
Log food every day. Hit 155 g protein: Oct 18 was the template (chicken, eggs, cottage cheese, casein). Land near 1,900 kcal, not 1,200.
Weigh in Mon, Wed, Fri mornings. Wear the Watch to bed and open the app daily so it syncs.
Photos Monday morning before training: front, side, back, same spot and light. No more weeks without a baseline.
photos: No progress photos on file, third week in a row. Take front, side and back Monday morning, same spot and light, or there's nothing to measure your recomp against.
